d:
Patna snatak MLC chunav men tamam siyasi ataklon aur 'bhumihar banam bhumihar' ke drame ke bad aakhirkar niraj kumar ne jit ka parcham lahra diya hai. "pudina sinh" vale tanj aur "27 tarikh ko gais nikalne" vale bayanon ke bich natijon ne sabit kar diya ki niraj kumar ka siyasi hajma aaj bhi utna hi durust hai!
Is chunav men jahan anant sinh ke ummidvar anuj sinh tisre nanbar par khisak kar sirph 'vot katva' sabit hue, vahin asli mukabla JDU ke niraj kumar aur RJD ke dilip kumar ke bich raha. virodh, pike ke hamlon aur mokama ke siyasi tiron ke bich niraj kumar adig aur atal rahe.
